results.note: Poenitentiale Gerundense: No English translation found. Searches for this early medieval penitential from Girona/Gerona returned no modern English translation.
Probationes variae: No English translation found. This medieval Latin text on proofs/tests is not documented in English translation sources.
Sermo de S. Clodoaldo: No English translation found. Though St. Clodoald is documented in hagiographic sources, this specific sermon is not attested in English translation.
Versus in coena Domini et Parasceve et Sabbato Sancto: No English translation found. This medieval liturgical poetry is not documented in English translation sources.
Annales Floriacenses: No English translation found despite searches in medieval chronicle databases. Related annals (Annals of Fulda, Royal Frankish Annals) exist in English, but not this one.
Additamentum ad acta S. Henrici: No English translation found. Medieval supplementary text on St. Henry is documented in scholarship but no English translation identified.
Additamentum ad vitam S. Cunegundis: No English translation found. Academic literature on St. Cunigunde exists, but not a published English translation of this supplement.
Quomodo initianda sit synodus: No English translation found. This text on initiating synods is not documented in modern English translation sources.
Annales S. Emmerammi: No English translation found. Medieval chronicle from St. Emmeram monastery in Regensburg has no documented English translation.
De monasterio Fiscamnensi: No English translation found. Medieval description of Fiscamnensis monastery is documented in PL but not in English translation.
De monasterio Fructuariensi: No English translation found. Medieval text on Fructuariensi monastery (possibly San Benigno in Italy) lacks English translation.
De revelatione aedificatione et auctoritate monasterii Fiscamnensis: No English translation found. Identified in Persée as 11th-century Norman monastery chronicle but no English translation.
Descriptio censuum proventuum ac fructuum S. Emmerammi: No English translation found. Administrative medieval document from St. Emmeram monastery (1031) lacks English translation.
Encomium: No English translation found. Medieval encomium (possibly hagiographic) not documented in English translation sources.
Laus vitae monasticae: No English translation found. Medieval monastic poetry praising monastic life lacks modern English translation.
Vita altera S. Guillelmi: No English translation found. Alternative biography of a saint William is not documented in English translation.
Annales Augienses brevissimi: No English translation found. Brief annals from Reichenau Abbey (Augia dives) lack documented English translation.
Annales Augienses: No English translation found. Despite identification in medieval chronicle databases, no English translation is documented.
Epitaphia Senonensia: No English translation found. Medieval epitaphs from Sens lack documented English translation.
Epitaphium Seifridi: No English translation found. Medieval epitaph of an individual named Seifrid lacks English translation.
Hymnus de S. Odilone: No English translation found. Liturgical hymn on Saint Odilo of Cluny lacks documented English translation.
Missa Odilonis: No English translation found. Liturgical Mass for/by Odilo lacks documented English translation.
Vita Halinardi: No English translation found. Biography of Archbishop Halinard of Lyon (1046-1052) and abbot lacks documented English translation.
Analecta de S. Herlembaldo: No English translation found. Collection of selected pieces on Saint Herlembaldo lacks English translation.
Litaniae veteres ecclesiae Bellovacensis: No English translation found. Ancient litanies of the Beauvais church lack documented English translation.
Miracula patrata Beneventi: No English translation found. Collection of miracles performed at Benevento lacks documented English translation.
De Gallica profectione Petri Damiani: No English translation found. Anonymous 11th-century account (1063) of Peter Damian's journey to France/Cluny lacks English translation.
Expositio canonis missae secundum Petrum Damianum: No English translation found. Medieval exposition on the Mass canon lacks documented English translation.
Testimonia Novi Testamenti: No English translation found. Medieval biblical testimonies/proof-texts from New Testament lack documented English translation.
Chronicon breve Bremense: No English translation found. Brief chronicle of Bremen lacks documented English translation despite scholarly discussion.
Epitaphium Lietberti: No English translation found. Epitaph of Bishop Lietbert of Cambrai (fl. 1076) lacks documented English translation.
Acta archiepiscoporum Rotomagensium: English translation by Richard Allen published in Tabularia (2009) as part of critical edition and translation project.
Benedictio abbatis canonicorum: No English translation found. Blessing for abbots of canons lacks documented English translation.
Benedictio abbatis monachorum: No English translation found. Blessing for abbots of monks lacks documented English translation.
Benedictio abbatissae: No English translation found. Blessing for abbesses lacks documented English translation.
Benedictio chrismatis: No English translation found. Blessing of chrism/holy oil lacks documented English translation.
Benedictio episcopalis in Sabbato sancto: No English translation found. Episcopal blessing for Holy Saturday lacks documented English translation.
Benedictio episcopalis in nocte Nativitatis Domini: No English translation found. Episcopal blessing for Christmas Eve lacks documented English translation.
Benedictio in solutione synodi: No English translation found. Blessing for the closing of synods lacks documented English translation.
Catalogus abbatum Fiscamnensium: No English translation found. List of abbots of Fiscamnensis monastery documented in PL bibliography but no English translation.
Catalogus archiepiscoporum Mediolanensium: No English translation found. Medieval catalog of Milan archbishops (1355) lacks documented English translation.
Chronicon Fiscamnense: No English translation found. Chronicle of Fiscamnensis monastery lacks documented English translation.
De expositio baptismatis et eucharistae: No English translation found. Exposition on baptism and eucharist lacks documented English translation.
De festivitatibus sanctorum: No English translation found. Medieval text on saints' feast days/festivals lacks documented English translation.

Expositio divinorum officiorum: No English translation found. Medieval exposition on divine offices lacks documented English translation (distinguished from Durand's Rationale divinorum officiorum which has translations).
